purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: expert interview; vocabulary (貿易/統一/承認/検証/提示) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今の貿易の課題は、何ですか?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 基準の統一が、最大の課題です。
lines.en: Unifying standards is the biggest challenge.
lines.style: composed analyst voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 承認の手続きは、複雑ですか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 承認には、丁寧な検証が要ります。
lines.style: patient analyst voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 提案は、どう提示するんですか?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: データを提示し、検証してもらいます。
lines.en: We present data and have it verified.
lines.style: composed analyst voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 統一が進めば、貿易は楽になりますか?
lines.en: If unification advances, does trade get easier?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、統一が、貿易を滑らかにします。
lines.style: warm analyst voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
